claims.text: SPA's English release of the Royal Court announcement of King Fahd's death names the announcer as Crown Prince Abdullah bin Abdulaziz, the Deputy Premier and Commander of the National Guard.
claims.locator: Dateline 'Riyadh, Aug 1'; paragraph 1; trailer (11:22 local time)
claims.uncertainty: A point observation of his styles at the announcement; it does not establish when his crown-princeship began. The English dateline has no year: the date rests on the Arabic original (26 Jumada II 1426 / 1 August 2005), which styles him Crown Prince only.
